domain_analysis.mixed_group_rule: MIXED_DOMAIN_GROUP preserves legacy P/E/D and blocks only single-Domain attribution

model_identity_policy.api_mode_role: transport audit only; chat and responses do not split AnalysisModelKey
model_identity_policy.ambiguity_rule: two or more known candidates => MODEL_CONFIG_AMBIGUOUS and block formal statistics
model_identity_policy.explicit_difference_rule: known differences in core fields remain separate AnalysisModelKeys

bundled_open_source_samples.composition: synthetic schema examples only; no formal stimuli or participant data

factorial_analysis.risk_A1_B1: dynamic full/partial-cross numeric design; complete sample target 3x21=63 cells; group-by-base slopes and constant-outcome diagnostics
factorial_analysis.cni_conflict: full 2x2x2 exploratory response factorial; 7 outcomes x 7 main/interaction effects

statistical_freeze.human_gap_scenario_resampling: 5000 GroupID resamples with fixed seed 20260827; independent new module
statistical_freeze.D: existing equal-weight formula, 80% coverage gate, t interval, sign-flip and Holm behavior retained
statistical_freeze.E: existing point estimate and interpretation retained; no bootstrap interval

human_reference.aggregation: participant-within-condition equal-weight ItemID, then equal-weight participants

risk_human_reference.primary_curve_scope: CategoryID comprehensive curve: ItemID-first, then equal-weight across all four application GroupIDs at each x
risk_human_reference.base_probability_rule: A1 and B1 retain three separate curves and three separate crossovers; no pooled/common crossover
risk_human_reference.secondary_curve_scope: individual application GroupID, including the closest monetary analogue
risk_human_reference.coverage_rule: at least 80% planned repeats per ItemID, all planned GroupIDs per comprehensive point, and all planned x points per curve
risk_human_reference.ranking_distribution_rule: six complete rankings retained at every real x point; never pooled across cost levels

memory_management.csv_parser: Blob stream + streaming TextDecoder + projected single-pass parser
memory_management.jsonl_json_handling: extension-level short circuit; files are not read

full_export.dataset_count_source: js/export.js DATASET_INFO; validated by automated contract test
